statement: During the SUE-569 dogfood run's L1 comparative review (l1:dogfood-2026-09-05-g04-vs-g01), a specific uncited figure was found in this text: "한 보존 프로그램은 2001년 이후 약 20년에 걸쳐 550만 권가량을 처리했고" — no footnote, named institution, or source note anywhere in the fixture supports the "약 20년" / "550만 권" numbers. Thesis-worth and language-native-prose were tie on the same review, so this is not a wholesale quality problem — it is one specific, identifiable factual-support gap.

routing.rationale: A specific, precise figure asserted with no citation or attributable source is exactly editorial/feedback-routing.json's verification layer symptom "an unsupported material claim" — not a frame, audience, or prose issue. It is not routed to polish: rewording around an unsupported number would hide the problem rather than fix it (verification layer's own do_not entry against polish).
